review:
Hacksaw's cheeky Zeus goes Epic, with a huge 50,000x max. It's a cluster game: squares behind wins become Divine Squares, and a Hand of Zeus switches them on to reveal Bronze, Silver or Gold coins.

Zap of Zeus multiplies nearby coins and vessels by up to 10x, and Vessels of Wealth collect every coin on the grid. Three FS give 8 spins where squares stay until used; four give 12 where they stay even after; five start the Epic Bonus with Zeus's hand every spin. Rated 5/5, RTPs of 96.22%, 94.16% and 92.35%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
